notes: Operation-level EVM gas values from published blockchain access-control systems.
Values for ACS-IoT and IoTChain are approximate readings from bar charts (Fig 7 in each paper).
null indicates the system does not expose that operation or does not report gas for it.

ACS-IoT.source: Rashid et al., Wireless Personal Communications (2024), Fig 7 — Ropsten testnet

issue.note: TX3 Policy_Creation (~160k from Fig 7, highest TX)

check.note: VW operations are free read-only calls (Fig 7)

IoTChain.source: Putra et al., IEEE IoT Journal (2021), Fig 7 — Rinkeby testnet

revoke.note: No explicit revoke transaction in IoTChain
